title: Label the stock level
prompt: For every product, return name, stock and level. level is out when the stock is 0, low when it is from 1 to 9, and ok when it is 10 or more. The starter never produces out.
hints: Which test does a stock of 0 meet first in the starter?
The first true test decides, so the most specific test has to come first.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Leaves out ELSE, so well-stocked products get NULL.
Counts a stock of exactly 10 as low.

feedback: Check three products: one with a stock of 0, one with a stock of exactly 10, and one with plenty.
